## Coverage and exclusions

The source is [Cricsheet's international match archives](https://cricsheet.org/downloads/).
Available counts above cover the five-year window; used counts additionally apply
the fixed-XI and outcome rules. Tests retain draws and ties. ODIs and T20Is require
a decisive result. No-results and matches with ambiguous XIs or recorded match
replacements do not enter the models. All players in eligible matches are ranked;
low appearance counts are flagged, not removed.

This is not a census of international cricket. Source coverage differs by format
and gender, and Cricsheet withholds some Afghanistan-related matches. The source
remains subject to [Cricsheet's licensing terms](https://cricsheet.org/licensing/).
The [preparation guide](pipeline.qmd) explains identity checks and date exclusions.

## Using the downloads

Join players by stable Cricsheet person ID, not printed name. Keep format, gender,
cutoff, and comparison group in the key when comparing ratings. Do not add scores
across separately fitted models. A rating is a log win/loss odds coefficient;
it is not a count of wins or a replacement-level estimate.

The saved publication is verified before every website build. Rendering regenerates
format tables from those files without downloading match data or fitting models.
See [reproduction commands](pipeline.qmd) and the
[publication history](https://github.com/outside-edge/player_value/commits/main/out/release/current).
